verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a hosted scraping API. Developers can attach a JavaScript scenario (an instruction list such as click, fill, wait and scroll) to individual API calls. The CLI can run crawls, including a Scrapy-project spider, and cron-based schedules. However, no evidence shows that developers can upload, build or deploy their own custom scraping scripts to run serverlessly on ScrapingBee's platform. These features are adjacent request-level or CLI capabilities, not hosted custom-script deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
